result.topic_en: Geodetic coordinate computations for Braunschweig: logarithmic triangle reductions from Andreas–Brocken, Lichtenberg and Windmühle 1 and 2, giving rectangular coordinate differences.

methods.what: Computation of rectangular coordinates of a station by adding logarithmic coordinate differences (log distance + log sine/cosine of azimuth) to coordinates of a reference point
Reduction of azimuth and logarithmic distance using a correction of $-19'55''$ in angle and $+0,27186$ in log scale
Coordinates of Windmühle I and II obtained by adding computed coordinate differences to the Braunschweig reference coordinates
